name: Battle Master
description: Tactical combatant who uses maneuvers to control the battlefield and outplay opponents.

name: Path of the Ancestral Guardian
description: Barbarian who channels the protection of ancestral spirits and guards allies from harm.

name: Way of the Open Hand
description: Monk who turns precise strikes and disciplined movement into devastating control.

name: Life Domain
description: Cleric focused on healing, protection, and sustaining the party.

name: Hunter
description: Ranger whose mastery of the hunt makes them relentless in pursuit and ambush.

name: Arcane Trickster
description: Rogue who blends stealth, precision, and magic in cunning attacks and misdirection.

name: College of Lore
description: Bard whose studies extend beyond performance into magic, history, and broad expertise.

name: Champion
description: Fighter who excels at raw combat power, precision, and relentless offense.
